name: QEF Solver Initialization
definition: Prepares the QEF system for solving by computing the centroid and assembling the symmetric matrix $A^T A$ and vector $A^T b$.
summary: QEF Solver Initialization computes the centroid and assembles symmetric linear system matrices from accumulated data, transitioning raw input into the solvable structure required by the Dual Contouring QEF Solver.
